title: spring.security.oauth2.resource.jwt
description: Two buckets: spring.security.oauth2.resource.jwt.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.security.oauth2.resource.jwt.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.security.oauth2.resource.jwt.instances.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

issuer-uri.description: OAuth2/OIDC issuer identifier; discovered to a JWKS endpoint via .well-known/openid-configuration

issuer.description: Overrides the expected iss claim (defaults to issuer-uri)

public-key.description: Inline PEM-encoded RSA or ECDSA public key

public-key-file.description: Path to a PEM-encoded public key file

algorithm.description: Pin one signing algorithm, e.g. RS256, HS256, ES256

jwks-timeout.description: Duration string bounding each discovery/JWKS fetch
